concerns.text: The plan does not explicitly reference the `feature_matrix.schema.yaml` contract (contracts/feature_matrix.schema.yaml) when generating topological feature matrices. The contract expects fields `target_property` and `target_value`, but the plan only mentions creation of `TopologicalDescriptor` without these target fields, creating a mismatch between the data model and contract.

The `model_metrics.schema.yaml` contract requires a `feature_importance` object for both traditional and topological descriptors, yet the plan’s description of `FR-003` and the `ModelPerformance` entity omit any generation or recording of feature importance, leaving the contract unexercised.
